preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and len(stdin.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: stdin consists of exactly two lines: first line is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5), second line contains n space-separated integers f(1), ..., f(n) where each f(i) is in [1, n].

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (stdout.count('\n') == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**6 for x in stdout.split() if x.isdigit()))
postconditions.description: If no valid m, g, h exist, stdout is exactly '-1'. Otherwise, stdout consists of three lines: first line is m (1 ≤ m ≤ 10^6), second line is n space-separated integers g(1), ..., g(n) (1 ≤ g(i) ≤ m), third line is m space-separated integers h(1), ..., h(m) (1 ≤ h(j) ≤ n).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (lambda: (lambda m, g, h: all(g[int(h[j]) - 1] == j for j in range(1, m + 1)) and all(h[g[int(x) - 1] - 1] == int(f_list[int(x) - 1]) for x in range(1, n + 1)) if (m := int(stdout.split()[0])) and (g := list(map(int, stdout.split()[1:n + 1]))) and (h := list(map(int, stdout.split()[n + 1:]))))())()
postconditions.description: If stdout is not '-1', then the output satisfies: (1) g(h(x)) = x for all x ∈ [m], and (2) h(g(x)) = f(x) for all x ∈ [n], where f_list is the parsed input function f.
